blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: How can a world model continuously observe regions beyond the actor’s current view? Video world models simulate how an environment evolves from an agent’s actions, yet remain actor-centric. Once an object leaves the actor’s view, they lose direct evidence of its evolution, often failing to preserve its state and dynamics upon re-entry. To address this, we introduce World Observer , which decouples observing from acting by jointly generating a perspective actor for the agent-centric view with one or more panoramic observers that watch selected world regions. This allows objects that leave the actor’s view to remain visually evolving in an observer, so their updated states are reflected when they re-enter. We ground the actor and observers by warping from a shared panoramic source for explicit geometric correspondence, and introduce an Observer Sink of high-resolution perspective references to restore fine appearance upon re-entry. Since the observers are decoupled from the actor, they can be placed freely across the scene, extended to multiple locations for broader coverage, and driven by control signals to steer out-of-view evolution. To evaluate out-of-view evolution, we further introduce world-space metrics and a benchmark spanning real and synthetic scenes. World Observer substantially improves out-of-view dynamics while remaining competitive in visual fidelity, camera control, and 3D adherence.
blocks.zh: 世界模式如何能持续观察超越行为者当前观点的区域? 影视世界模型模拟环境如何从代理行为中演化, 一旦物体离开演员的视线,它们就会失去其演变的直接证据,在重返时往往无法保持其状态和动态. 为了解决这个问题,我们介绍了世界观察家,它与观察选定世界区域的一个或多个全景观察家联合为以代理人为中心的观点创造视角,从而将观察与行动脱钩。 这使得离开演员视线的物体可以在观察器中保持视觉进化,因此其更新的状态在重新进入时得到反映. 我们通过从一个共同的全景源对演员和观察者进行曲折,以进行明确的几何通信,并引入高分辨率视角参考的Sink观察者,以恢复重返时的精细外观。 由于观察者与演员脱钩,他们可以自由横跨场景,扩展至多个地点以扩大覆盖范围,并受控制信号驱动以引导视野外演化. 为了评估视野外的演变,我们进一步引入了世界空间指标和涵盖真实和合成场景的基准。 世界观察家大大改进了视线外动态,同时在视觉忠诚、相机控制和3D遵守方面保持竞争力。

blocks.en:
World models ( NVIDIA et al., 2025b ; Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ; Team HY-World et al., 2026 ; DreamX Team et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Dai et al., 2025 ; Seo et al., 2026 ) simulate how environment evolves by generating future observations conditioned on an agent’s actions.
Existing models remain actor-centric , updating the world primarily through what the actor currently observes, so whatever lies outside that view is left without direct visual evidence. A persistent world model should thus keep the world evolving regardless of where the actor looks, as regions outside the view can still affect the scene (Fig. 1 (a)) and dynamic content keeps evolving even after it goes out of sight (Fig. 1 (b)).
Such persistence matters for applications such as embodied navigation ( Li et al., 2025a ) , interactive simulation ( Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; NVIDIA et al., 2025a ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026 ; DreamX Team et al., 2026 ) , and long-horizon planning ( Li et al., 2026a ) , where an agent must reason about a world beyond its current observation.

现有模式仍然以演员为中心,主要通过演员目前观察到的情况更新世界,因此,这种观点之外的任何内容都得不到直接的视觉证据。 因此,一个持久的世界模式应使世界不断演变,而不论行为者的外观如何,因为视线以外的区域仍然会影响到场景(图1(a)),动态内容即使在视线之外也不断演变(图1(b))。
此类应用的持久性问题,如体现导航(Li等人,2025a),互动模拟(Robbyant Team等人,2026;Wang等人,2026b;NVIDIA等人,2025a;Zhu等人,2026;Tang等人,2026;DreamX) Team et al., 2026),以及长视线规划(Li et al., 2026a),一个特工必须为其当前观察之外的世界提出理由.

blocks.en: However, existing world models ( NVIDIA et al., 2025b ; Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ; Team HY-World et al., 2026 ; DreamX Team et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Dai et al., 2025 ; Seo et al., 2026 ) often fail to maintain unobserved states. As illustrated in Fig. 2 , we observe four characteristic failure modes that arise when an object moves out of the actor view. Fig. 2 (a) shows a frame-locked state , where an object that should move out of view under camera motion instead remains unnaturally locked to the image frame. Lu et al. (2026) attributes this to models overemphasizing salient image-space subjects. Fig. 2 (b) shows a lost state , where an object disappears after leaving the actor view and fails to reappear when the actor looks back. Fig. 2 (c) shows a frozen state , where the object is retained but its dynamics stop evolving while unobserved, so it reappears near its last visible state. Fig. 2 (d) shows an impostor state , where the object reappears with a plausible but incorrect state evolution that is inconsistent with what actually occurred while it was unobserved.

blocks.en: The core limitation is that world-state maintenance remains tied to the actor’s observation, as which regions are continuously represented depends on where the actor looks. Once an object leaves the actor’s observation, the model loses direct visual evidence of how its state evolves. Existing approaches compensate through internal memory ( Chen et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2025 ) , generative priors ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , or explicit state extrapolation ( Duan et al., 2026 ) . However, these approaches infer the unseen evolution from previously observed information rather than directly observing what happens after the object leaves the view. As unobserved intervals grow longer or scene dynamics grow more complex, this inference becomes increasingly uncertain, causing state drift ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) and temporal inconsistency ( Chen et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Ma et al., 2026 ) . The key challenge is therefore not merely to remember the last observed state, but to keep regions of interest observable regardless of where the actor looks . This raises a natural question: How can a world model continuously observe regions beyond the actor’s current view?
blocks.zh: 核心限制是维持世界状态仍然与行为者的观察有关,因为哪些地区持续得到代表取决于行为者的外表。 一旦一个物体离开演员的观察,模型就会失去关于其状态如何演变的直接视觉证据. 现有方法通过内存补偿(Chen等人,2026年b;Wang等人,2026年a;Wu等人,2025年),基因前科(徐等人,2026年),或明确状态推断(Duan等人,2026年). 然而,这些方法推断出之前观测到的信息的无形演变,而不是直接观察物体离开视野后发生的事情. 由于未观测到的间隔延长或场景动态增加复杂,这种推论越来越不确定,造成状态漂移(Lu等人,2026年;Ma等人,2026年)和时间不一致(Chen等人,2026年b; Chen等人, 2026a; Ma等人, 2026 ). 因此,关键的挑战不仅仅是要记住最后观察到的状态,而是要让感兴趣的地区能够观察,无论行为者的外表如何。 这自然提出了一个问题: 世界模式如何能持续观察超越行为者当前观点的区域?

blocks.en: Our answer is to decouple observing from acting . We introduce World Observer , which jointly generates one or more observers that watch chosen regions together with an actor that renders the agent-centric view. To cover a broad surrounding region from a single observer location, we instantiate each observer as a 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} panoramic video. Generated jointly, the actor and observers share a single world state, so a state seen by the actor continues in its observers and vice versa. Objects covered by an observer thus remain represented and evolve even outside the actor’s view and reappear with updated states, mitigating the frame-locked, lost, frozen, and impostor failures.
blocks.zh: 我们的答案是把观察与行动分开 我们介绍《世界观察家》,它联合产生一名或多名观察者,观察选定的区域,并有一个行动者使这种看法以代理人为中心。 为了从一个观察地点覆盖一个广阔的周边区域,我们即刻将每个观察者作为360QQ360Qcirc}全景视频. 联合生成,演员和观察者共享一个单一的世界状态,所以演员所看到的状态继续在其观察者中,反之亦然. 因此,观察者所覆盖的物体仍然具有代表性,甚至在角色的视线之外也不断演变,并随着更新的状态而重新出现,从而减轻了框锁、丢失、冻结和冒牌失败。

blocks.en: A panoramic observer provides broad spatial coverage, but transferring its evolving world state to the perspective actor requires bridging geometric and appearance differences between the two representations. By warping the initial panorama into each viewpoint, we provide explicit geometric correspondences between overlapping regions of the actor and observer views. However, the observer’s panoramic distortion limits the fine appearance detail available to the actor. We therefore introduce an Observer Sink , a set of fixed high-resolution perspective references cropped from the initial panorama and accessed through shared attention. Together, the evolving observer and these appearance references help the actor render returning regions with updated states and fine detail.
blocks.zh: 一个全景观察者提供广阔的空间覆盖,但将它不断演变的世界状态转移给视角角色需要两个代表物之间沟通几何和外观差异. 通过将最初的全景分析到每个角度,我们提供了演员和观察者观点重叠区域之间的明确几何对应。 然而,观察者全景扭曲限制了演员可获得的精细外观细节. 因此,我们介绍“Sink”观察员,这是一套从最初的全景中整理出来的、通过共同关注获得的固定高分辨率视角参考。 不断演变的观察员和这些外观参考物共同帮助行为者使回归区域具有更新的状态和细节。

blocks.en: Since observers are not tied to the actor, we can choose which regions to be observable independently of the actor’s position and view. In Fig. 1 (b), fixed multiple observers watch regions the actor cannot see, allowing occluded objects to remain tracked and re-enter consistently. Decoupling the observer from the actor also enables independent observer control, allowing us to guide how out-of-view regions evolve (Fig. 1 (a)). Training such observers requires viewpoint-synchronized captures that are difficult to obtain in the real world, so we complement real panoramic videos with a synthetic CARLA ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2017 ) dataset that provides these observer configurations.
blocks.zh: 由于观察者与行动者没有联系,我们可以选择哪个地区是独立于行动者的立场和观点而观察的。 在图1(b)中,固定的多个观察者监视着行为者无法看到的区域,使被占有的物体能够始终如一地跟踪和重新进入。 将观察员与行为者脱钩也使得独立观察员能够进行控制,使我们能够指导视野外区域的演变(图1(a))。 训练这样的观察者需要视野同步的捕获,这些在现实世界中很难获得,因此我们用一个合成的CARLA(Dosovitskiy等人,2017年)数据集来补充真实的全景视频,提供这些观察者的配置.

blocks.en: Finally, we evaluate whether objects continue to evolve correctly while outside the actor view. Existing benchmarks ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) largely focus on single, centered targets, while VLM-based metrics ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) mainly assess visual plausibility, so neither directly measures whether objects in moving, multi-object scenes evolve coherently while out of view. We therefore introduce world-space metrics that lift objects into 3D with a segmentation model ( Carion et al., 2026 ) and a metric-scale depth estimator ( Lin et al., 2025 ) . OOV-D gt {}_{\text{gt}} measures whether out-of-view motion agrees with ground-truth dynamics, OOV-D self {}_{\text{self}} measures whether generated dynamics stay self-consistent through the interval, and OOV-F reports valid leave-and-return cases. World Observer significantly improves out-of-view dynamics while remaining competitive on visual fidelity, camera control, and 3D adherence.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们评价物体是否在角色视图之外继续正确演变。 现有基准(马等人,2026年;卢等人,2026年;陈等人,2026年b)主要侧重于单项,中心目标,而基于VLM的度量衡(卢等人,2026年;马等人,2026年;陈等人,2026年a)主要评估视觉可视性,因此既不直接衡量移动中的物体,多物体场景是否在脱离视线的同时一致演变. 因此,我们引入了将物体升入3D的世界空间度量衡(Carion等人,2026年)和测量尺度深度估计器(Lin等人,2025年)。 OOV-D gt QQText{gt}} 度量外运动是否同意地面真实动态,OOV-D自我QQText{self}}度量产生动态是否通过间隔保持自我一致性,OOV-F报告有效的休假和回归案例. 世界观察家显著改进了视外动态,同时在视觉忠贞性,相机控制和3D的坚持性方面保持竞争力.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. • We introduce World Observer , which decouples acting from observing, generating a perspective actor with panoramic observers that keep the regions beyond the actor’s view. • We decouple the observer from the actor, allowing us to freely place observers alongside the actor, at fixed viewpoints, or across scenes for broader coverage and out-of-view control. • We introduce OOV-D gt {}_{\text{gt}} and OOV-D self {}_{\text{self}} for 3D out-of-view dynamic consistency, OOV-F for valid leave-and-return cases, and a benchmark spanning real and synthetic scenes.

blocks.en: World Observer is trained on temporally synchronized actor and observer videos, built from two sources. Real panoramic video grounds generation in real-world appearance, while a synthetic simulator provides the decoupled and multi-observer configurations that real captures rarely contain.
blocks.zh: 世界观察家接受关于时间同步的演员和观察者视频的培训,这些视频来自两个来源。 真实世界外观中真实的全景视频场生成,而合成模拟器则提供真捕获很少包含的解耦和多观测器配置.

blocks.en: Real-world dataset. From an existing panorama corpus ( Luo et al., 2026 ; Xia et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , we curate high-resolution videos with stable motion and stabilize each into an upright, non-rotating equirectangular observer sequences. We then render synchronized perspective actor videos from the stabilized panorama under randomized trajectories and estimate per-frame depth with Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) for the geometry-aware condition (Sec. 3.2 ). Since both views come from the same panorama, real pairs are co-located, so we use synthetic data for observers decoupled from the actor and for multi-observer settings. Details are in Appendix B.2 .
blocks.zh: 真实世界数据集. 从现有的全景体(Luo等人, 2026年;Xia等人, 2025年;Chen等人, 2024年)中, 我们用稳定的运动来整理高分辨率的视频, 并且将每个视频稳定为直立的,非旋转的等距观察序列 。 然后在随机化的轨迹下将稳定全景的同步视角演员视频制作出来,并用深度Anything 3(Lin等人,2025年)估计每帧深度,以表示几何感知状况(第3.2节). 由于两种观点都来自同一全景,真对子是合位的,所以我们使用合成数据来观察与演员脱钩的观察者和多观察者设置. 详情见附录B.2。

blocks.en: Synthetic dataset. We render videos in CARLA ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2017 ) using the same stabilization and augmentation as the real data. The simulator lets us place observers independently of the actor, from one decoupled observer to several synchronized observers at different locations, providing complementary coverage (Fig. 3 ). Details are in Appendix B.3 .

blocks.en: World Observer jointly generates video streams of two roles that share a single world. An actor renders the agent’s local view, while one or more panoramic observers maintain broader world state and dynamics beyond it. Both streams are generated by a single pretrained video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) ( NVIDIA et al., 2025b ) in the latent space of a 3D VAE, and each stream is conditioned on its own text prompt and camera trajectory. Long-horizon videos are generated autoregressively in chunks of T T frames, using tail latents of the previous chunk as history. Fig. 4 shows the overview.

blocks.en: 3.1 Joint Actor-Observer World Modeling
blocks.zh: 3.1 联合演员-观察员世界建模

blocks.en: While the actor cannot see beyond its view, the world keeps evolving. We therefore model the panorama as a time-varying observer jointly generated with the actor, rather than a static reference. Objects leaving the actor’s view keep evolving in the observer, and both streams share this state, so re-entering regions remain consistent with the observer instead of having its out-of-view evolution synthesized from scratch. The observer thus serves as an evolving world-state stream rather than static context.
blocks.zh: 虽然行为者无法超越自己的观点,但世界却在不断演变。 因此,我们把全景作为与演员共同创造的时空观察者,而不是静态参考。 离开演员视线的物体在观察者中不断演化,两条溪流都分享这种状态,因此重新进入的区域与观察者保持一致,而不是从零开始合成其视线外演化. 因此,该观察员是一个不断变化的世界国家流,而不是静态环境。

blocks.en: View-time alignment. We concatenate actor and observer latents with their history latents from the previous chunk into a single sequence processed by shared DiT, adding learnable view embeddings to distinguish streams. Since both depict the same world at the same time, we assign matched actor and observer latents identical positions on the RoPE ( Su et al., 2023 ) temporal axis, allowing self-attention to exchange information across corresponding timesteps. As shown in Fig. 5 , a query on a re-entering object can attend to the observer region at the same timestep, where its out-of-view state is maintained.

blocks.en: Decoupled actor-observer prompting. The actor and the observer share one evolving world but describe different parts, so we condition them on separate prompts. The actor prompt 𝐏 a \mathbf{P}^{\mathrm{a}} specifies events within the actor’s local view, while the observer prompt 𝐏 o \mathbf{P}^{\mathrm{o}} specifies events across the surrounding world, including regions the actor does not see. Since both streams are jointly generated and synchronized, this gives the observer two roles. It acts as memory , since events leaving the actor view continue evolving in the observer, so a subject seen walking away keeps moving while unobserved. It also acts as control , since the observer prompt can drive unseen events, such as an off-screen interaction, which the actor then observes when it looks there.
blocks.zh: 脱钩演员-观察者提示. 演员和观察者分享着一个不断演变的世界,但描述了不同的部分,所以我们把它们作为不同的提示条件. 演员提示 P a \ mathbf{ P}^{\ mathrm{a}} } 指定在演员本地视野内的事件, 而观察者提示 P o\ mathbf{ P}^{\ mathrm{o}} } 指定在周围世界范围内的事件, 包括演员看不到的地区. 由于两条流都是共同生成和同步的,这使得观察者有两个角色. 它起到记忆的作用,因为离开演员视线的事件在观察者中不断演变,所以一个被看到离开的主体在无人观察的情况下不断移动. 它也起到控制的作用,因为观察者提示可以驱动隐形事件,例如非屏幕交互,然后演员在看那里时会观察到.

blocks.en: 3.2 Panoramic Observer Modeling
blocks.zh: 3.2 全景观察者模拟

blocks.en: Since the panorama provides a shared view of the initial surroundings across all directions, we ground both streams in it through warping, fixing each stream’s camera condition and aligning actor and observer geometry. Because the observer only has to maintain the world state rather than serving as the displayed output, we generate it at a flexible resolution. A panorama, however, inevitably carries geometric distortion, which loses fine appearance and weakens the correspondence between the observer and the actor. We therefore introduce an Observer Sink, a perspective reference from panorama that restores this appearance and correspondence when a region re-enters the actor view.
blocks.zh: 由于全景提供了横跨所有方向的初始环境的共同视角,我们通过扭曲来将两条溪流铺设在其中,修复每条溪流的相机状况,并调整演员和观察者几何结构. 因为观察者只需要维持世界状态,而不是作为显示的输出,所以我们以灵活的解决方案产生它. 然而,全景不可避免地带有几何扭曲,从而失去了精致的外观,削弱了观察者与演员之间的通信. 因此,我们介绍一个Sink观察者,从全景的角度参考,当一个区域重新进入演员视野时,它恢复了这种外观和通信。

blocks.en: Panoramic warping. Joint modeling shares information between the streams but does not fix the viewpoint each should render or how the actor and observer views correspond. We ground both in the initial panorama x 0 o x^{\mathrm{o}}_{0} , whose 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} coverage provide a shared view of the surrounding scene. Using its metric-scale depth D 0 D_{0} from DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , we warp this shared source into each stream’s viewpoints along its own trajectory. For a target frame of stream s ∈ { a , o } s\in\{\mathrm{a},\mathrm{o}\} at pose c t s c^{s}_{t} , x warp , t s = Render ⁡ ( Unproj ⁡ ( x 0 o , D 0 o ) , c 0 → t s ) , x^{s}_{\mathrm{warp},t}=\mathrm{Render}\bigl(\mathrm{Unproj}(x^{\mathrm{o}}_{0},\,D^{\mathrm{o}}_{0}),\;c^{s}_{0\to t}\bigr), (3) where c 0 → t s c^{s}_{0\to t} transforms the initial observer panorama to the target pose. Each warped video is encoded by the 3D VAE and channel-wise concatenated with the corresponding noisy latents and a binary validity mask marking covered pixels. Since both streams use the same panorama and depth, they are geometrically consistent by construction, giving shared attention a direct correspondence between the actor view and its observer region. We further channel-wise concatenate a Plücker raymap ( Sitzmann et al., 2022 ) with each stream’s latent features to encode its viewpoint.

blocks.en: Decoupled resolution. Because the actor and observer play different roles, their resolutions need not match. The actor is the displayed output and must preserve visual detail, whereas the observer only maintains world state, so we generate it at a lower resolution R o < R a R^{\mathrm{o}}<R^{\mathrm{a}} , where R a R^{\mathrm{a}} is the actor resolution. Coarse spatial-temporal structure, object locations, motion, and visibility changes, is enough for the observer to track out-of-view dynamics, which keeps full- 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} coverage tractable.
blocks.zh: 解结解脱. 由于演员和观察者扮演不同的角色,他们的决议不需要匹配. 演员是显示的输出,必须保存视觉细节,而观察者只维持世界状态,所以我们在下分辨率R o < R a R ^{\mathrm{o}}<R^{\mathrm{a}},其中R ^{\mathrm{a}}是演员分辨率. 粗糙的空间-时态结构,物体位置,运动,和能见度的变化,足以让观察者追踪到视野外的动态,这保持了完整的-360 QQ 360^{\circ}的覆盖性.

To supply this, we introduce an Observer Sink , a high-resolution perspective reference. blocks.en: 3.3 Flexible Observer Placement
blocks.zh: 3.3 灵活观察员职位安排

blocks.en: Why flexible observers. An observer that simply follows the actor is constrained by the actor trajectory and cannot independently monitor a region of interest. However, important state updates may occur away from the actor, and such regions should remain observable regardless of where the actor moves. We therefore also consider a flexible single-observer setting, where the observer trajectory 𝐂 o \mathbf{C}^{\mathrm{o}} can be spatially separated from and move independently of the actor trajectory 𝐂 a \mathbf{C}^{\mathrm{a}} , enabled by our synthetic data construction in Sec. 3 . Beyond this, a single observer may still be insufficient when relevant regions are spatially separated or mutually occluded. We therefore further extend the formulation to N > 1 N>1 observers, allowing multiple observer streams { 𝐗 o n } n = 1 N \{\mathbf{X}^{\mathrm{o}_{n}}\}_{n=1}^{N} to maintain evolving state across different parts of the shared world.
blocks.zh: 为什么是灵活的观察者。 仅仅跟随演员的观察者受到演员轨迹的限制,无法独立地监测一个感兴趣的区域. 然而,重要的国家最新情况可能发生在行为者之外,无论行为者在何处行动,这些地区都应保持可观察性。 因此,我们也考虑一个灵活的单一观测器设置,即观察者轨迹C o\ mathbf{C}^{\ mathrm{o} 可以在空间上与演员轨迹 C a\ mathbf{C}^{\mathrm{a}}}分离并独立移动, 由我们在 Sec 3 的合成数据构建启用 。 除此之外,如果相关区域在空间上相互分离或相互渗透,则单一观察员可能仍然不足。 因此,我们进一步将这一表述扩展至N > 1 N>1观察员,允许多个观察员流{X o n} n = 1 N \{\ mathbf{X}^{\mathrm{o}_{n}}\}_{n=n=1}^{N}在共享世界不同地区保持不断发展的状态.

blocks.en: Multi-observer joint modeling. For N > 1 N>1 , we instantiate one panoramic stream for each observer 𝐗 o n \mathbf{X}^{\mathrm{o}_{n}} and add an observer-specific learnable embedding to distinguish the streams. The actor stream and all N N observer streams are concatenated into a single sequence and jointly generated by the same DiT. For each actor trajectory frame, we select the initial observer panorama x 0 o n x^{\mathrm{o}_{n}}_{0} whose corresponding observer pose is closest to the current actor position and use it as the geometric source for actor-view warping. This keeps the actor condition grounded in a nearby panorama for stable camera control while allowing the geometric reference to transition between observers as the actor moves through the scene. For each generation chunk, the Observer Sink is constructed from the closest observer selected from chunk’s first frame, so its high-resolution appearance reference remains consistent with the geometric source. Meanwhile, all observer streams continue to evolve jointly, maintaining a coherent shared world across their different regions of coverage.
blocks.zh: 多观测联合建模. 对于 N > 1 N > 1, 我们为每个观察者 X o n\ mathbf\ mathrm{o\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\%\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ 演员流和所有NN观察流被调和成一个单一的序列,并由同一DiT共同生成. 对于每个演员轨迹框架,我们选择初始观察者全景x0 o n x^{\ mathrm{o}_{n}}_{0},其相应的观察者姿势最接近当前演员位置,并用作演员-视界拼音的几何来源. 这使得演员的条件被植根于附近的全景中,以进行稳定的相机控制,同时在演员穿过场景时允许几何参照物在观察者之间过渡. 对于每一代块来说,观测者Sink是由从块的第一个框中选择的最接近的观察者构建的,因此其高分辨率的外观参考仍然与几何源一致. 同时,所有观察员流继续共同演变,在覆盖的不同区域维持一个连贯的共同世界。

blocks.en: 4.1 Out-of-View Dynamics Metric
blocks.zh: 4.1 视频外动态计量

blocks.en: Existing evaluations rely largely on semantic cues or VLM judgments, which struggle to quantify how multiple objects move while out-of-view. We instead measure out-of-view dynamics explicitly in world space. Using a segmentation model ( Carion et al., 2026 ) and a metric-scale depth estimator ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , we lift each object into 3D and track its position over time, turning unobserved motion into real-world displacement with comparable direction and magnitude across methods.
blocks.zh: 现有的评价主要依靠语义提示或VLM判断,这些判断难以量化多个对象在视线外时如何移动. 相反,我们明确衡量世界空间的外观动态。 使用分块模型(Carion等人,2026年)和度量衡深度估测器(Lin等人,2025年),我们把每个物体升入3D并跟踪其位置随时间推移,将无观测运动转变为真实世界的移动,不同方法的方向和规模相当.

blocks.en: We measure two aspects of displacement for objects that validly exit and re-enter the actor’s view. OOV-F reports how often objects follow the ground-truth exit-and-re-entry pattern, capturing the frame-locked and lost failures with no valid displacement. For objects that exit and return, OOV-D measures how well out-of-view motion matches a reference. We use two references. OOV-D gt {}_{\text{gt}} compares motion with the ground-truth dynamics specified by the prompt, while OOV-D self {}_{\text{self}} checks whether the object continues pre-exit motion. Accordingly, OOV-D gt {}_{\text{gt}} is more sensitive to frozen motion, whereas OOV-D self {}_{\text{self}} is more sensitive to impostor motion. Details are in Appendix C.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们为有效离开和重新进入行动者视野的物体衡量流离失所的两个方面。 OOV-F报告说,物体经常遵循地面真实的退出和重返模式,在无有效转移的情况下捕捉被锁定和丢失的故障。 对于退出和返回的对象,OOV-D测量出视运动是否与引用匹配. 我们使用两个参考。 OOV-D gt QQText{gt} 比较运动与提示指定的地面真实动态,而OOV-D 自我QQText{self} 则检查对象是否继续出局前运动. 因此,OOV-D gt QQText{gt}}对冷冻运动比较敏感,而OOV-D自QQText{self}}对冒牌运动比较敏感. 详情见附录C.3。

blocks.en: We build held-out benchmarks on real panoramic video and synthetic CARLA video, unseen during training, with 100 100 sequences each ( 200 200 in total) of T = 77 T{=}77 frames. We evaluate within a single chunk, where the full sequence fits in context and no memory retrieval is needed. This isolates whether the model genuinely maintains out-of-view dynamics, since under an unlimited-memory single chunk a failure cannot be attributed to limited context or missing retrieval. Each sequence uses a back-and-forth camera rotation with random angle and speed and contains one or more objects undergoing natural out-of-view motion, also provided as a text prompt.

For panorama world models, whose output is a full panorama rather than a perspective view, we crop a perspective view from the output using the ground-truth camera rotation, making their output directly comparable to our perspective actor. As shown in Tab. 1 and Fig. 7 , World Observer performs favorably in visual and temporal fidelity, camera-following accuracy, and 3D adherence, while achieving the strongest out-of-view dynamics. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented World Observer , which decouples observing from acting by jointly generating a perspective actor with panoramic observers that maintain world state beyond the actor’s view. This formulation keeps out-of-view regions explicitly represented as the world evolves, allowing their updated states to be reflected when they later re-enter the actor view. Panorama grounding and the Observer Sink preserve geometric consistency and fine appearance across actor and observer views, while decoupled observers enable flexible placement and control of out-of-view regions. We further introduced world-space metrics and benchmarks on real and synthetic scenes to directly evaluate this capability. Across these evaluations, World Observer better preserves out-of-view dynamics while remaining competitive in visual fidelity, camera control, and 3D adherence.
blocks.zh: 我们提出“世界观察家”方案,通过联合产生一个有全景观察家的视角演员,使世界状态维持在行动者的视线之外,从而将观察与行动脱钩。 随着世界的演进,这种提法保持了清晰的不景气区域,使得它们更新的状态在后来重新进入角色视野时得到反映. 全景定位和观察者Sink保持了各角色和观察者观点的几何一致性和精细外观,而脱钩观察者则能够灵活地放置和控制视野外区域。 我们还在真实和合成场景方面引入了世界空间指标和基准,以直接评价这种能力。 在整个这些评价中,世界观察家更好地保持视线外动态,同时在视觉忠诚、相机控制和3D遵守方面保持竞争力。

blocks.en: A.1 Video World Models
blocks.zh: A.1 视频世界模式

blocks.en: Building on recent advances in video generation ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Kong et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2025 ) , video world models adopt generative models to predict future observations from an actor-centric view. Some video world models ( NVIDIA et al., 2025b ; Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ) rely primarily on the generative prior learned from large-scale pretraining. To maintain a coherent world beyond the actor currently observes, recent approaches additionally retrieve relevant past observations ( Team HY-World et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; DreamX Team et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Yi et al., 2026 ) or maintain stored states in explicit spatial and geometric representations ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . However, generative priors, retrieved observations, and stored states still lack direct evidence of how dynamic content evolves once it leaves the actor view, leading to the frame-locked , lost , frozen , and impostor failures shown in Fig. 2 . In contrast, we jointly generate a panoramic observer that continues to represent the evolving world beyond the actor’s view, so that out-of-view dynamic content is explicitly generated.
blocks.zh: 在视频生成(Team Wan等人,2025年;Zheng等人,2024年;Kong等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年;Yin等人,2025年a;Huang等人,2025年)最新进展的基础上,视频世界模型采用了基因模型,从以演员为中心的视角预测未来的观测结果. 一些视频世界模型(NVIDIA等人,2025年b;Robbyant Team等人,2026年)主要依靠从大规模预训中事先学到的基因. 为了在行为者目前所观察到的范围之外维持一个连贯的世界,最近又重新收集了过去的相关观察(Team HY-World等人,2026年;Yu等人,2025年;DreamX) Team等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年b;Xiao等人,2026年;Yi等人,2026年b)或以明确的空间和几何表示法保持储存状态(Wu等人,2025年b;Li等人,2025年b); Yu等人, 2026; Li等人, 2026a). 然而,基因前科,检索到的观测结果,以及存储状态,仍然缺乏直接证据,说明动态内容一旦离开演员视野后是如何演化的,导致帧锁,丢失,冻结,以及假冒失败在Fig中显示. 2 (英语). 相比之下,我们联合产生了一个全景观察者,这个观察者继续代表着演进中的世界,超越了演员的视野,从而可以明确地产生出视野的动态内容.

blocks.en: A.2 Panorama World Models
blocks.zh: A.2 全景世界模式

blocks.en: To overcome the limited FoV of perspective models, prior work has explored panoramas either as intermediate representations for constructing coherent 3D worlds ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Schnepf et al., 2026 ; Team HY-World et al., 2026 ) or as direct world representations through panoramic video generation ( Yin et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026c ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Producing panoramas as the final output introduces additional challenges: pretrained backbones are typically optimized for perspective imagery, which has motivated tangent-plane or cubemap-based formulations ( Kalischek et al., 2025 ; Çapuk et al., 2025 ) , while representing the full sphere under a fixed token budget can reduce the effective resolution available to each viewing direction ( Li et al., 2026c ; Liu et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, we decouple observing from acting within an actor-observer framework, allowing one or more observers to observe selected regions independently of the actor’s position and view, while the perspective actor is jointly generated as the primary output. Because the observer maintains the surrounding world rather than serving as the actor view, it need not carry the actor’s fidelity, which sidesteps these resolution and prior limitations while the perspective actor stays high-quality.
blocks.zh: 为了克服视角模型中有限的FOV,先前的工作探索了全景或者作为构建连贯的3D世界的中间代表(Wang等人,2025年;Schnepf等人,2026年;Team HY-World等人,2026年),或者作为全景视频生成的直接世界代表(Yin等人,2025年b;Li等人,2026年b;Chen等人,2026年c;Liu等人,2026年). 制作全景图作为最后产出带来了更多的挑战:经过预先训练的骨干通常被优化用于展望图像,这种图像激发出切合飞机或立方体配方(Kalisek等人,2025年;Čapuk等人,2025年),同时在固定符号预算下代表整个领域可以减少每个视向的有效分辨率(Li等人,2026年c;Liu等人,2025年)。 与此相对照,我们将观察与在演员-观察者框架内的行动脱钩,允许一个或多个观察者独立观察特定区域的角色和观点,而视角演员则作为主要产出共同产生. 因为观察者维持着周围的世界,而不是作为演员的视角,所以它不需要背负演员的忠诚,在视角演员保持高品质的同时,它回避了这些分辨率和以前的局限性.

blocks.en: A.3 Out-of-View State and Dynamics
blocks.zh: A.3 州外和动态

blocks.en:
Recent benchmarks examine whether world models maintain evolving states when parts of the world become temporarily unobserved. STEVO-Bench ( Ma et al., 2026 ) tests state and dynamics consistency under controlled observation interruptions. WRBench ( Lu et al., 2026 ) evaluates state consistency when the camera moves away from a scene and later returns. MemoBench ( Chen et al., 2026a ) evaluates whether out-of-view objects re-enter with appropriately evolved states across diverse dynamic scenes, including physical state changes. These benchmarks, however, leave the judgment to a VLM, which rates whether a reappearance looks natural. In the dynamic, multi-object scenes world models produce, naturalness depends on where an object actually moved while unobserved, which such judgments cannot verify.
A few approaches address interrupted observation directly. HyDRA ( Chen et al., 2026b ) and ReMind ( Xu et al., 2026 ) use dynamic memory and generative priors to continue unseen dynamics, while LiveWorld ( Duan et al., 2026 ) and WorldDirector ( Wang et al., 2026a ) explicitly advance hidden states through simulation or motion planning. Yet generative approaches may drift toward plausible but incorrect unseen states, memory-based methods remain limited by previously observed evidence, and explicit state advancement requires structured entity-level modeling. We instead use a panoramic video as an evolving global observer that continuously captures out-of-view dynamics.
blocks.zh:
最近的基准审查当世界部分地区暂时无人注意时,世界模式是否维持不断演变的国家。 STEVO-Bench(Ma等人,2026年)在控制观测中断下测试状态和动态一致性. WRBench(Lu et al., 2026年)评价相机离开场景后返回时的状态一致性. Memo Bench(Chen et al., 2026a)评价外视物体是否在包括物理状态变化在内的各种动态场景中以适当进化的状态重新进入. 然而,这些基准则由自愿多数派作出判断,由他们判断重新出现是否自然。 在动态的,多对象的场景世界模型中产生,自然性取决于一个物体在不观察时实际移动的地方,这种判断无法验证.
有几种办法直接处理中断的观察。 HyDRA(Chen等人,2026b)和ReMind(Xu等人,2026年)使用动态记忆和基因前传继续无形的动态,而LiveWorld(Duan等人,2026年)和World Director(Wang等人,2026a)则通过模拟或运动规划明确推进隐藏状态. 然而,遗传学方法可能会转向可能但又不正确的隐形状态,基于记忆的方法仍然受到以前观察到的证据的限制,明确的状态进步需要结构化的实体一级模型。 相反,我们使用全景视频作为不断发展的全球观察者,不断捕捉出视动态。

blocks.en: During training, warping source is not fixed to the first frame of the training clip. We sample it from the full source video surrounding the clip, taking the nearest past or future frame beyond a minimum spatial distance from the target, so the condition is rarely a clean, well-aligned view of the target. This matches the autoregressive setting, where later chunks are warped from frames that are increasingly distant from the current viewpoint.
blocks.zh: 在训练期间,warping源没有固定在训练剪辑的第一帧. 我们从围绕片段的完整源视频中进行取样,取出距目标最小空间距离最近的过去或未来帧,因此条件很少是清晰,与目标完全一致的视角. 这与自动递归的设置相匹配,在这种设置中,后面的块被从越来越远离当前视角的框架扭曲。

blocks.en: To enable classifier-free guidance (CFG) and ensure graceful degradation when certain conditions are unavailable, we apply the following dropout schedule during training: text captions are replaced with empty-string T5 embeddings with a probability of 20 % 20\% , and Observer Sink tokens are zeroed out with a probability of 20 % 20\% . At inference we apply the same guidance scale to the actor and observer streams.
blocks.zh: 为了启用无分类引导(CFG),并确保在某些条件不存在时优雅的退化,我们在训练时应用以下退出时间表: 文本标题被替换为空弦 T5 嵌入,概率为20% 20% , 观察者 Sink 令牌被零化,概率为20% 20% 。 推论,我们对行为者和观察员流适用同样的指导尺度。

blocks.en: B.1.2 Additional model details
blocks.zh: B.1.2 其他模式细节

blocks.en: World Observer fine-tunes Cosmos-Predict2.5 ( NVIDIA et al., 2025b ) , a 2B-parameter Diffusion Transformer (DiT) with 28 blocks, 16 attention heads, and a hidden dimension of 2048. The model operates in a 16-channel latent space produced by a 3D VAE with 4 × 4\times temporal and 8 × 8\times spatial compression, so a chunk of T = 77 = 1 + 4 × 19 T{=}77{=}1{+}4\times 19 frames yields L = 20 L{=}20 latents per stream. We render the actor at R a = 1280 × 704 R_{\mathrm{a}}{=}1280\times 704 and the observer at R o = 640 × 320 R_{\mathrm{o}}{=}640\times 320 , so each observer contributes roughly a quarter of the actor’s tokens; despite its wider 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} coverage, the observer is kept at low resolution for a compact token budget and faster training and inference, which also keeps the joint sequence tractable as observers are added.
blocks.zh: 世界观察家微调宇宙-预测2.5(NVIDIA等人,2025b),一个2B参数的分散变形器(DIT),有28块,16个注意力头,隐藏的维度为2048. 该型号在由3D VAE产生的16通道潜伏空间中运行,时速为4×4×4×4×8×8×8×8×8的空间压缩,因此一整块T=77×1+4×19 T×77×1×4×19 19帧每流输出L=20L×20潜伏. 我们让演员在R a = 1280 × 704 R_{\mathrm{a}}{=}1280\times 704和观察员在R o = 640 × 320 R_{\mathrm{o}}{=}640\times 320,所以每个观察者贡献了大约四分之一的演员标志;尽管其范围更广的360 × 360\circ}覆盖度,但观察者在紧凑的标语预算以及更快的培训和推论上保持了低分辨率,这也使得联合序列可以作为观察者添加.

blocks.en: The DiT input is assembled along the channel axis before patch embedding, concatenating the noisy target latent, the encoded warped video, a warp validity mask, a learnable view embedding, and any extra warp streams, in this order. The view embedding is a learnable 6 6 -channel vector with one row for perspective and one for panoramic tokens, which distinguishes the two streams. To separate multiple observers, which share the panoramic row and would otherwise be indistinguishable, we add n ​ 𝐞 obs n\,\mathbf{e}_{\text{obs}} to the n n -th observer of the same type, where n n is a 0 0 -based index and 𝐞 obs \mathbf{e}_{\text{obs}} is a learnable vector. Since the first observer takes n = 0 n{=}0 , the multi-observer model reduces exactly to the single-observer one, so the single-observer checkpoint warm-starts multi-observer training without any change to the embedding table.

We build a 6 6 -channel Plücker ray map for each view at the latent resolution, equirectangular rays for the observer and pinhole rays for the actor, embed it with a patch embedder, and add it to the video tokens after patch embedding. This embedder is zero-initialized so that generation starts identically to the base model at the first step, keeping the warm-start clean.

blocks.en: B.2 Real Data Processing
blocks.zh: B.2 实际数据处理

blocks.en: B.2.1 Panorama Video Processing
blocks.zh: B.2.1 全景 视频处理

blocks.en: Raw 360° footage is unstable, as the rig rotates between frames with an arbitrary vertical axis, and warping it directly would entangle camera rotation with the scene geometry we want to recover. We therefore canonicalize every clip into a rotation-stabilized, gravity-aligned ERP sequence, following 360Anything ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . We render each ERP frame to a cubemap and recover per-frame rotation with COLMAP ( Schönberger and Frahm, 2016 ) to cancel inter-frame spin, then estimate the gravity direction with GeoCalib ( Veicht et al., 2024 ) and apply a rotation that aligns it with the ERP down axis.
blocks.zh: 原始360°的镜头是不稳定的,因为钻机用任意的垂直轴在帧之间旋转,直接拨动它会把相机旋转和我们希望恢复的场景几何缠绕在一起. 因此,我们把每个片段整合成一个旋转稳定、重力相配合的ERP序列,遵循360 Anything(Wu等人,2026年)。 我们把每个ERP框架制成立方体,并用COLMAP(Schönberger and Frahm,2016年)恢复每帧旋转,取消帧之间的旋转,然后与GeoCalib(Veicht等人,2024年)估算重力方向,并采用与ERP下轴对齐的旋转.

blocks.en: Panoramic depth estimation. Building the warping condition requires a high-resolution depth map over the full panorama. Since monocular depth estimators are trained on perspective images and cannot be applied directly to the distorted ERP panorama, we decompose the sphere into perspective views, predict depth at high resolution on each, and merge them back onto the sphere. For each depth keyframe we render 110-FOV perspective views along the vertices of an icosahedron, whose overlapping frusta cover every direction with at least two views. We pass these views to Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) in a single batch without external extrinsics, so the model observes all views jointly, resolves their relative poses internally, and returns depth in one common scale, removing the per-view scale alignment and the drift it introduces. The per-view depths are fused into one ERP depth map by weighted averaging, and camera poses are defined from the front-view extrinsics and completed over the full trajectory by SLERP and linear interpolation. The resulting depth and poses are used for raymap conditioning and warping at training time.
blocks.zh: 全景深度估计. 构建曲折条件需要高分辨率深度图覆盖全景. 由于单极深度估计器是接受视角图像培训的,不能直接应用于扭曲的ERP全景,因此我们把球体分解成视角,以高分辨率预测每个球体的深度,并把它们重新组合到球体上. 对于每一个深度键框,我们用110-FOV的视角来观察一个二面体的顶点,它相互重叠的花纹至少用两种视角覆盖每个方向。 我们将这些观点传递给深度Anything 3(Lin et al., 2025年),单独批次地没有外部外观,所以模型会共同观察所有观点,解决其相对在内部的形成,并以一个共同的尺度返回深度,取消了每个视图的尺度对齐和它引入的漂移. 以加权平均法将每个视野的深度并入一个企业资源规划深度图,从前视外观确定相机姿势,然后通过SLERP和线性插图在全轨迹上完成。 由此产生的深度和姿势用于训练时的射线映射调节和拨动.

blocks.en: B.2.2 Text captioning
blocks.zh: B.2.2 文本标题

blocks.en: We generate text captions for all training clips using the Qwen3.6-27B vision-language model. Following the 4-view panoramic captioning strategy of PanoWorld ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , we represent each panoramic frame using four 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} -FOV perspective crops corresponding to the Front, Right, Back, and Left directions, rather than directly captioning the raw equirectangular (ERP) frame. We adopt this representation to avoid directly exposing the vision-language model to the discontinuity at the ERP boundary and the strong projection distortion near the poles.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Qune3.6-27B视觉语言模型为所有培训剪辑生成文本标题。 按照PanoWorld(Jiang et al., 2026年)的四视全景字幕策略, 我们用四个90 QQ 90 ^{\circ} - FOV视角作物对应Front, Right, Back, and Left方向, 我们采用这种表述方式是为了避免将视觉语言模型直接暴露在企业资源规划系统边界的不连续性和极点附近的强烈投影扭曲。

blocks.en: For each clip, we generate one panorama caption and one perspective caption for each camera trajectory. Each caption describes the environment, dynamic actors, and specific events in the scene. By comparing observations across multiple timestamps for each viewing direction, the caption records objects that enter, leave, or change over time, including events occurring outside the current field of view of the perspective cameras. Because these out-of-view events are recorded directly in the caption, it carries information about how the scene’s dynamic state evolves outside a camera’s current field of view. The panorama caption summarizes these dynamics over the full panoramic view, while each perspective caption focuses on the content visible along its corresponding camera trajectory. The panorama caption is further required to describe scene dynamics without referring to screen position or compass direction. Camera behavior is described directly in each perspective caption’s prose, reflecting the sampled yaw, pitch, and field of view of the corresponding trajectory. We apply the same captioning procedure to the synthetic data.
blocks.zh: 每个片段,我们生成一个全景字幕和每个相机轨迹的一个视角字幕. 每个字幕描述环境,动态演员,以及场景中的具体事件. 通过比较每个取景方向跨多个时间戳的观测结果,标题记录了随时间推移而进入,离开,或变化的对象,包括发生在当前视野领域外的视角摄像头事件. 由于这些外景事件直接记录在字幕中,它包含了关于场景动态状态如何在镜头当前视野之外演化的信息. 全景字幕通过全景视图来总结这些动态,而每个视角字幕则侧重于其相应相机轨迹上可见的内容. 还需要全景字幕来描述场景动态,而不提及屏幕位置或指南针方向. 相机行为在每一个视角标题的旁白中直接描述,反映所采样的yaw, pitch,以及相应轨迹的视野. 我们对合成数据采用同样的标题程序。

blocks.en: B.2.3 Trajectory Construction
blocks.zh: B.2.3 轨迹建筑

blocks.en:
For each clip, we render six perspective-camera trajectories from the same temporal segment of a panoramic video. Each trajectory independently samples its field of view and pitch, which remain fixed throughout the clip, while roll is fixed at 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} . For all trajectories except origin , the reference yaw is independently chosen to be either aligned with the canonical forward direction or randomly sampled.
The six trajectories consist of two static and four moving views. The origin trajectory remains fixed at the canonical forward direction with zero yaw and pitch, while front_static remains fixed at its sampled reference orientation. The yaw_right and yaw_left trajectories continuously rotate to the right and left, respectively, with a randomly sampled total rotation angle and a rotation speed that varies over time. The out_back_right_first and out_back_left_first trajectories first rotate in the specified direction and then reverse direction. The rotation angles before and after the reversal are sampled independently, and the reversal point is randomly selected within the clip. This construction provides diverse starting viewpoints and camera motions while keeping all six perspective views temporally aligned with the source panorama.
blocks.zh:
每个片段,我们从一个全景录影带的同一时间段制作6个透视镜头轨迹. 每个轨迹独立地取样其视野和投球场,在整个弹夹中一直固定,而滚球则固定在0 0^{\0^{\circ}. 对于除来源以外的所有轨迹,参考yaw是独立选择的,要么与犬科前向方向对齐,要么随机取样.
六个轨迹包括两个静态和四个移动的视图. 原生轨迹仍固定在峡谷前方方向上,零 ya和投球,而前_静态则固定在其取样的参考方向上. yaw_right和yaw_left 轨迹分别持续向左右旋转,随机抽取总旋转角度,旋转速度随时间变化. 出局_右_第一和出局_左_第一轨首先在指定方向旋转,然后逆向旋转. 反转前后的旋转角度是独立取样的,反转点在剪辑内随机选择. 这种构思提供了不同的起始观点和相机运动,同时保持了所有六种视角在时间上与源全景一致.

blocks.en: B.3 Synthetic Data Processing
blocks.zh: B.3 合成数据处理

blocks.en: We use CARLA ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2017 ) to construct our synthetic video dataset, drawing on both the Unreal Engine 4 build (v0.9.15), from which we use Town01 , Town02 , Town03 , Town05 , and Town10 , and the Unreal Engine 5 build (v0.10.0), from which we additionally use Town10 . We randomly spawn vehicles and pedestrians before rendering to simulate realistic traffic, and render each clip under an independently sampled weather and lighting condition, combining clear and overcast presets with noon or sunset time of day and jittering cloudiness, sun altitude, and fog, so that appearance, illumination, and traffic all vary across the dataset. We additionally render metric depth maps and extract camera parameters per frame to support geometric referencing.
blocks.zh: 我们利用CARLA(Dosovitskiy等人,2017年)构建了我们的合成视频数据集,同时借鉴了不真实引擎4号楼(v0.9.15),从中我们使用Town01,Town02,Town03,Town05,Town10,以及Town5号楼(v0.10.0),从中我们额外使用Town10号楼. 在模拟现实交通之前,我们随机地产下车辆和行人, 在独立采样的天气和照明条件下制作每一片段, 将清晰的和覆盖的预设与中午或日落时间相结合, 并震动云层、太阳高度和雾, 这样,外观、照明和交通在数据集中都各不相同。 我们还绘制了测量深度图,并提取每个帧的相机参数,以支持几何参照。

blocks.en: Panoramic actor-observer capture. CARLA does not natively expose an equirectangular (ERP) camera, so we assemble each panorama from a cubemap rig of six pinhole RGB-D cameras ( 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} FOV, 960 × 960 960\times 960 each) captured in lock-step within a single simulation tick and stitched into a 360 ∘ × 180 ∘ 360^{\circ}\times 180^{\circ} ERP panorama and depth map. Each clip contains one moving actor and two static observers, all captured with such rigs at an eye height of 1.6 ​ – ​ 1.8 1.6\text{--}1.8\, m. The actor walks along these waypoints at a per-clip speed sampled uniformly from 1.3 ​ – ​ 3.5 1.3\text{--}3.5\, m/s. The waypoints are sampled at roughly 10 10\, m spacing along each map’s sidewalk lanes. The two observers are placed at the waypoints nearest to the start and end of a longer rendered sequence, so the actor’s offset from each observer varies across clips. Because all three rigs advance under the same simulation clock, they witness the same vehicles and pedestrians at the same instant, giving time-aligned observations of one evolving world that real footage cannot provide. For each observer we store its t = 0 t{=}0 panorama and depth as a forward-warp source.
blocks.zh: 全景演员-观察者捕捉. CARLA并不在本地暴露一个等效的摄像头, 所以我们从一个立方体的钻机里组装每个全景 由6个针孔的 RGB-D 摄像头(90 ∘ 90 ^{\circ}FOV,960 × 960 960\times 960) 捕获在一个单一的模拟滴中, 并缝合成360 ∘ 180 ∘crc} 180 ^{\circ}ERP全景图和深度图。 每个片段包含一个移动的演员和两个静止的观察者,都用这种钻机在1.6–1.8 1.6\text{-}1.8\,m. 演员沿着这些路口走,每条剪切速度从1.3 – 3.5 1.3\text{ -}3.5\,m/s统一抽取. 道路标点的采样时间为每条地图的行人行道相距约10/10米。 两位观察者被安排在距离一个较长的序列的起始点和结尾点最近的点,因此每个观察者的演员与每个观察者的抵消因片段而异. 因为这三套钻机都在同一模拟时钟下推进,所以它们在同一瞬间见证了同样的车辆和行人,对一个演化中的世界给出了真实镜头无法提供的时序的观察. 对于每个观察者,我们将其 t = 0 t = = 0 的全景和深度存储为前卫战源.

blocks.en: Appendix C Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 评价 细节

blocks.en: C.1 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: C.1 基准建设

blocks.en: The benchmark videos are constructed so that every clip poses the same well-defined challenge. The camera rotates away from its starting heading and then returns to it, causing one or more dynamic objects to leave the field of view and later re-enter. Clips are drawn from the same real and synthetic (CARLA) sources used for training. We first restrict candidate scenes to those containing fewer than 10 dynamic objects in total, so that individual objects remain visually uncluttered and unambiguous to track and describe. Within each such scene, we crop a perspective view whose camera rotates away from its initial heading and then returns to it. This controlled motion deliberately causes objects to leave the frame and later re-enter, rather than relying on incidental camera motion. We then manually curate 1-3 objects per scene (human, vehicle, or animal) that unambiguously exit through a frame edge and later re-enter, discarding candidates whose exit or re-entry is ambiguous or does not occur. For the multi-observer setting, the two observer panoramas are captured at the start and final positions of the actor trajectory, both at the first timestep.
blocks.zh: 基准视频的构建使得每个片段都提出了相同的明确的挑战. 相机从它的起始方向旋转,然后返回到它,导致一个或多个动态对象离开视域,然后重新进入视域. 剪辑取材自用于培训的同样真实和合成来源。 我们首先将候选场景限制在总共含有不到10个动态物体的场景,这样单个物体就保持视线清晰,清晰,可以跟踪和描述. 在每一个这样的场景中,我们画出一个视角,它的镜头从最初的航向旋转,然后返回到它. 这种受控运动故意使物体离开帧后再次进入,而不是依靠偶然的相机运动. 然后,我们手动整理每个场景(人类、车辆或动物)的1-3个物体,这些物体通过框架边缘毫不含糊地离开,然后重新进入,抛弃那些退出或重新进入不明确或没有发生的候选人。 对于多观测器设定,两个观察者全景在演员轨迹的起始位置和最终位置上被捕获,两者都是在第一次步.

blocks.en: C.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: C.2 评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluate generation quality along four aspects: visual and temporal fidelity with FID ( Heusel et al., 2018 ) and FVD ( Unterthiner et al., 2019 ) , image quality with VBench ( Huang et al., 2023 ) , camera-following accuracy with RotErr and TransErr, and 3D adherence with masked PSNR and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) . Both Real-OOV-Bench and Synthetic-OOV-Bench provide ground-truth videos, and all metrics are reported separately on the two benchmarks. For panorama world models, whose output is a full panorama, we crop a perspective view using the ground-truth camera rotation and compare it against the ground-truth perspective, matching our actor output. For the reference-based metrics, we resize each model’s output and the ground truth to a common resolution so they are compared under the same spatial scale. Below we detail how each metric is computed.
blocks.zh: 我们按四个方面来评价生成质量:视觉和时间忠于FID(Heusel等人,2018年)和FVD(Unterthiner等人,2019年),图像质量与V Bench(Huang等人,2023年),相机跟随精度与RotErr和TransErr,3D跟随蒙面的PSNR和LPIPS(Zhang等人,2018年). Real-OOV-Bench和Synthetic-OOV-Bench都提供地面实况录像,所有衡量标准都分别报告这两个基准。 对于全景世界模型,它的输出是全景,我们用地面-真实相机旋转来绘制视角视图,并与地面-真实相机视角进行比较,与我们的演员输出相匹配. 对于基于参考的衡量标准,我们将每个模型的输出和地面真实度调整为一个共同的分辨率,以便在相同的空间尺度下加以比较。 下面我们详细说明每个衡量标准是如何计算的。

blocks.en: 3D adherence. PSNR and LPIPS are computed between the generated video and the ground-truth video. Because our model targets dynamic video generation grounded in real-world references rather than exact 4D reconstruction, dynamic objects in the generated video need not match those in the ground truth. To focus these metrics on how faithfully the model preserves static scene structure, we segment dynamic objects in both generated and ground-truth frames using SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) with text prompts for dynamic categories (pedestrian and vehicle), and compute PSNR and LPIPS only over the static regions.
blocks.zh: 3D坚持. PSNR和LPIPS是在生成的视频和地面真实视频之间计算的. 因为我们的模型以基于真实世界参考的动态视频生成为对象,而不是精确的4D重建,因此生成的视频中的动态对象不需要与地面真理中的对应. 为了使这些衡量标准侧重于模型如何忠实地维护静态场景结构,我们利用SAM3(Carion等人,2026年)在生成和地面真实框架中分解动态物体,并附有动态类别的文字提示(pedestrian and vehictor),并仅在静态区域上计算PSNR和LPIPS。

blocks.en: Camera-following accuracy. We extract per-frame camera extrinsics from the generated frames using Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , and take the ground-truth extrinsics from the same estimator applied to the ground-truth frames. Running the same estimator on both sides removes any bias between predicted and reference poses; for the synthetic benchmark we likewise use the DA3 estimates rather than the simulator poses, so that both benchmarks are evaluated identically. We process frames in non-overlapping chunks and compute relative poses by setting the first frame as the identity. Each translation trajectory is independently normalized by its maximum translation norm to remove scale ambiguity. RotErr is the mean geodesic distance on SO ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SO}(3) between the predicted and ground-truth relative rotations, and TransErr is the mean ℓ 2 \ell_{2} distance between the scale-normalized relative translations, following ( Li et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: 相机跟踪精度。 我们利用深度Anything 3(Lin等人,2025年)从生成的帧中提取每帧相机外部镜像,并从同样应用于地面真实帧的估算器中提取地面真实外镜。 在双方进行同样的估计可以消除预测和参考面图之间的任何偏差;对于合成基准,我们同样使用DA3估计,而不是模拟面图,以便两个基准得到同样的评价。 我们用非重叠块处理帧,通过设定第一个帧作为身份来计算相对的姿势. 每个翻译轨迹通过最大翻译规范独立正常化,以消除尺度模糊. RotErr是SO QQ(3)\mathrm{SO}(3)预测与地面真实相对旋转之间的平均大地测量距离,TransErr是比例尺正常相对翻译之间的平均l 2\ell%2},紧随其后(Li等人,2025b).

blocks.en: C.4 Comparison with Existing Out-of-View Metrics
blocks.zh: C.4 与现有检验外计量的比较

blocks.en: Figure 9: Comparison with existing Out-Of-View metrics. VLM-based metrics fail to identify frozen and impostor states as inconsistent, while our 3D displacement-based metrics quantitatively capture these failures.
blocks.zh: 图9:与现有 " 越野 " 指标的比较。 以VLM为基础的衡量标准未能确定冻结和冒充者的说法不一致,而以3D流离失所为基础的衡量标准则在数量上记录了这些失败。

blocks.en: Existing out-of-view benchmarks, such as MemoBench ( Chen et al., 2026a ) and WRBench ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , use VLM judges to decide whether an object stays consistent while out of view. The core difficulty is inherent to world models, where both the camera and the objects move, so an object’s true motion cannot be read off the rendered frames directly. Judging whether a re-appearing object has evolved naturally requires recovering how it actually moved in 3D, which VLMs estimate poorly from frames alone. As a result, once an object re-appears, VLMs often cannot tell natural evolution from a frozen or impostor state, and misjudge exactly the cases these benchmarks target.
blocks.zh: 现有的视野外基准,如Memo Bench(Chen等人,2026a)和WRBench(Lu等人,2026年),使用VLM判断器来判断一个物体是否在视野外时保持一致性. 核心难度是世界模型所固有的,相机和物体同时移动,因此一个物体的真实运动不能直接从渲染的帧读取. 判断一个重新出现的物体是否已经演化,自然需要恢复它在3D中的实际移动方式,而VLMs仅从帧中估计到这一点就很差. 因此,一旦一个物体重新出现,VLM往往无法从冷冻状态或假冒状态分辨自然演变,并错误判断这些基准目标的案例.

blocks.en: Fig. 9 shows two such cases from our evaluation. In the frozen case, asked “Is the object’s motion consistent before, during, and after the interval?”, the VLM answers “Yes,” although the object has actually stopped. In the impostor case, asked “Does the car’s trajectory remain logical and continuous even when it is out of frame?”, it again answers “Yes,” although the reappearing motion no longer follows the object’s own prior trajectory. We follow the question format of these benchmarks, yet both judgments are wrong.
blocks.zh: 图9显示了我们评价中的两起此类案件。 在被冻结的情况下,有人问 " 物体的运动在间隔之前、期间和之后是否一致? " , VLM回答 " 是 " ,尽管物体实际上已经停止。 在冒牌货案中,有人问道, " 汽车的轨迹即使离框,是否仍然合乎逻辑和连续? " ,它再次回答 " 是 " ,尽管重新出现的运动不再遵循物体自己以前的轨迹。 我们遵循这些基准的问题格式,但两项判决都是错误的。

blocks.en: Our metric instead measures 3D displacement explicitly. We lift each object with a segmentation and depth model, so we can quantify how much it actually moved out of view. OOV-D gt {}_{\text{gt}} exposes the frozen case, since the observed displacement is far smaller than the ground-truth reference, and OOV-D self {}_{\text{self}} exposes the impostor case, since the out-of-view motion departs from the object’s own pre-exit trajectory. Both failures the VLM judge misses are thus identified quantitatively.
blocks.zh: 我们的衡量标准是明确衡量3D流离失所。 我们用一个分割和深度模型来提升每个物体, 这样我们可以量化它到底移动了多少。 OOV-D gt text{gt} 揭露了冰冻的个案, 因为观测到的转移比地面真实的参考要小得多, OOV-D 自我 {text{self} 揭露了假冒的个案, 因为视线外运动偏离了物体自己的出院前轨迹。 因此,从数量上查明了自愿解运法官失职的两次失误。

blocks.en: C.5 Baseline Adaptation
blocks.zh: C.5 基线适应

blocks.en: Existing world models adopt different camera-conditioning interfaces, including continuous camera poses, Plücker ray embeddings, and discretized action controls. We therefore convert each benchmark camera trajectory into the representation expected by the corresponding model while preserving the underlying motion.
blocks.zh: 现有的世界模型采用不同的相机-空调接口,包括连续相机外观,普吕克射线嵌入,以及盘状动作控制. 因此,我们将每个基准摄影机轨迹转换成相应的模型所期望的表示,同时保留基本运动.

blocks.en: OmniRoam ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . OmniRoam uses a reference-space camera trajectory defined at the latent temporal resolution. Since its released panoramic conditioning path models camera translation without explicit rotational control, we re-base the benchmark trajectory to the first frame, retain only the translational component, and map it to OmniRoam’s reference coordinate system.
blocks.zh: OmniRoam (刘等, 2026). OmniRoam使用潜在时间分辨率界定的参考空间相机轨迹。 由于它发布全景性调制路径模型的相机翻译没有明确的旋转控制,我们把基准轨迹重新定位到第一帧,只保留翻译组件,并将其映射到OmniRoam的参考坐标系统.

blocks.en: PanoWorld ( Li et al., 2026b ) . PanoWorld conditions its Action-Model on relative camera translation and yaw. We compute camera centers from the benchmark extrinsics, express their displacement in the first-camera coordinate system, and map the resulting motion to PanoWorld’s panoramic coordinate convention. Relative yaw is measured with respect to the initial camera orientation, while translation is preserved at its original metric scale without additional normalization.
blocks.zh: PanoWorld(Li等人,2026年b). PanoWorld将其Action-Model作为相对相机翻译和yaw的条件. 我们从基准外部计算相机中心,在第一相机坐标系统中表达它们的位置,并将由此产生的运动映射到PanoWorld全景坐标会议。 相对的yaw是按初始相机方向测量的,而翻译则按其原始的度量尺度进行保存,而不会进一步正常化。

blocks.en: HyDRA ( Chen et al., 2026b ) . HyDRA is evaluated using its native out-of-view reconstruction protocol rather than the shared start-frame generation protocol. For each sequence, we identify the trajectory apex and split the ground-truth video into a context segment before the apex and a target segment after it. Camera poses are then expressed relative to the first target frame and sampled at the model’s latent temporal resolution. Since the model generates a fixed-length sequence, we evaluate only the frames corresponding to the valid target interval.
blocks.zh: HyDRA (Chen等人, 2026b ). HyDRA使用其原生的视野外重建协议而不是共享的启动帧生成协议来评价. 对于每个序列,我们确定轨迹顶端,并将地面真实视频在顶端之前分为上下文段,在顶端之后分为目标段. 然后对第一个目标框架表示相机外观,并在模型的潜在时间分辨率上取样。 由于模型产生固定长度序列,我们只评价与有效目标间隔对应的帧.

blocks.en: HY-World 1.5 ( HunyuanWorld, 2025 ) . HY-World 1.5 conditions generation on both continuous camera poses through PRoPE and discretized translation and rotation actions. We subsample the benchmark trajectory to the model’s latent temporal resolution, express the poses relative to the first frame, and derive the corresponding discrete motion labels from the same relative trajectory. Pose normalization follows the convention used during training.
blocks.zh: HY-World 1.5 (Hunyuan World, 2025). HY-World 1.5. (英语). HY-World 1.5 连续相机上的条件生成通过PROPE和盘式翻译和旋转动作来进行. 将基准轨迹与模型潜在的时间分辨率作比较,表达与第一帧相对的姿势,并从同一相对轨迹中得出相应的离散运动标签。 Pose正常化遵循培训期间使用的公约。

blocks.en: Dream-X ( DreamX Team et al., 2026 ) . Dream-X conditions generation on camera poses through Projective Rotary Position Embedding (PRoPE). We directly convert the benchmark world-to-camera trajectories into the model’s RealEstate10K-style pose representation, express them relative to the first frame, and preserve the original metric translation scale.
blocks.zh: 梦 - X (梦 - X) Team等人,2026年). 梦想 X 通过投影旋转器位置嵌入(PROPE)在相机上生成条件. 我们直接将基准世界对相机的轨迹转换成模型的RealEstate 10K风格的布局表示,表达它们与第一帧的相对关系,并保存原始的公制翻译尺度.

blocks.en: FantasyWorld ( Dai et al., 2025 ) . FantasyWorld represents camera motion using per-pixel 6-channel Plücker ray embeddings. We rescale the benchmark intrinsics to the generation resolution and construct the camera conditioning using the model’s official Plücker embedding implementation. Following the released inference procedure, camera translations are normalized using a scene scale estimated from monocular depth of the initial frame.
blocks.zh: "最终幻想世界"(Dai等人,2025年). Fantasy World 使用每像素 6 通道代表相机运动 普吕克射线嵌入. 我们调整生成分辨率所固有的基准, 按照所发布的推论程序,相机翻译通过从初始帧的单极深度估计的场景尺度实现正常化.

blocks.en: LingBot-World ( Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ) . LingBot-World conditions each transformer block on 6-channel Plücker ray maps. We convert the benchmark world-to-camera poses to camera-to-world poses and provide intrinsics that preserve the benchmark field of view in the model’s reference coordinate system. Camera translation magnitude is preserved, while trajectory normalization is handled by the model’s native inference pipeline.
blocks.zh: 凌博特-世界(Robbyant Team等人,2026年). 灵灵 6道每个变压器块的瓶-世界条件 普吕克射线图. 我们把基准世界到相机模型转换成相机世界模型,并提供内在内容,在模型的参考坐标系统中保持基准视野。 摄影机的翻译量被保留下来,轨迹正常化则由模型的原生推导管处理.

blocks.en: Matrix-GAME 3.0 ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . Matrix-GAME 3.0 conditions generation on interactive camera controls. We convert each benchmark camera trajectory into the corresponding control sequence by decomposing the relative camera motion into translational and rotational components and mapping them to the model’s supported controls. The resulting sequence is applied throughout generation using the model’s native inference pipeline, while preserving the direction and temporal progression of the benchmark trajectory.
blocks.zh: 矩阵-GAME 3.0(Wang等人,2026年b). Matrix-GAME 3.0条件生成在交互式相机控制上. 我们通过将相机的相对运动分解成翻译和旋转组件,并将其映射到模型所支持的控制上,将每个基准相机轨迹转换成相应的控制序列. 由此产生的顺序在一代人中采用模型的原生推论管道,同时保持基准轨迹的方向和时间进展。

Without the observer, the model cannot keep an object consistent while it is out of view, and the object re-enters with a changed state or appearance (Fig. 11 (b)). blocks.en: Effect of joint generation. The state-memory role of joint generation is most pronounced under autoregressive rollout. Without joint generation, the only information available to the actor is the Observer Sink and the recent actor history, so the model cannot maintain how the state evolves outside the field of view, and all memory is ultimately confined to the actor view. Joint generation instead lets the actor generate the dynamics within its view while tracking out-of-view dynamics through the observer. Retrieving past frames during rollout, as prior models do, only recalls observations from specific past timesteps. The model must then generate dynamics without knowing how the state progressed out of view between those observations and the present. Consistent with this, removing joint generation fails to keep out-of-view motion self-consistent and markedly lowers OOV-D self {}_{\text{self}} (Tab. 2 ). In contrast, from the history panorama alone, our model goes beyond static memory and continuously evolves the out-of-view dynamics that retrieval-based approaches cannot carry forward (Fig. 12 (b)).
blocks.zh: 联合生成的效果。 在自动推出的情况下,联合生成的状态-记忆作用最为突出。 没有联合世代,演员所能获得的唯一信息就是观察者辛克和近代演员历史,因此模型无法维持状态如何在视野外演化,所有的记忆最终都局限于演员视角. 联合生成则让演员在其视野内产生动态,同时通过观察者跟踪视野外动态. 在推出时检索过去的帧,就像以前的模型一样,只回顾过去特定时间步的观测结果. 然后,该模型必须产生动态,而不知道国家是如何在这些观测结果与现在之间脱离视野的。 与此一致的是,移除联合生成无法保持视线外运动自符合性,明显降低OOV-D自QQText{self}}(Tab. 2). 相比之下,仅从历史全景来看,我们的模式就超越了静态记忆,不断演化出基于检索的方法无法推进的视野外动态(图12(b))。

blocks.en: Effect of the Observer Sink. The effect of the Observer Sink becomes more visible as the camera moves more aggressively. To show this, we run inference on a trajectory that moves forward while continuously rotating to the right, sweeping a full 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} . Without the Observer Sink, so fine appearance quality degrades as the rotation grows and errors accumulate over the rollout. The Observer Sink supplies high-resolution perspective references covering the surroundings of the initial panorama, so that regions undergoing such large viewpoint changes are still rendered faithfully when they re-enter the actor view (Fig. 12 (c)).
blocks.zh: 辛克观察员的影响。 随着摄像头更猛烈地移动,观察者辛克的作用变得更加明显. 我们以前进的轨迹为例, 没有观察者Sink,那么精细的外观质量会随着旋转的增高和推展过程中的误差累积而退化. 观察员Sink提供了涵盖初步全景周边的高分辨率视角参考,这样,正在经历如此大视角变化的区域在重新进入演员视角时仍能忠实地实现(图12(c))。

blocks.en: The world perceived by the actor and the world perceived by the observer are inevitably different. Prior world models can only be controlled through the actor prompt, so a prompt describing something outside the actor’s view is forced to hallucinate within the region the actor currently sees. We instead decouple the observer prompt so that control acts on the broader world the observer covers. Fig. 13 (a) shows an event that can only be expressed with knowledge of the full surrounding scene. Placed in the actor prompt, it is hallucinated inside the actor’s view. Placed in the observer prompt, the observer generates it in the surrounding world, and the actor observes it only when it comes into view. Fig. 13 (b) shows a different failure of a unified prompt. The actor, which cannot see the surroundings, hallucinates the subject in its own view, and because the two streams are generated jointly, this hallucination propagates to the observer even though the observer already places the subject correctly. The result is a duplicate, with an additional Santa appearing while another is already seated in the armchair. Decoupled prompting avoids this by assigning each stream a prompt consistent with what it should observe.
blocks.zh: 演员所感知的世界和观察者所感知的世界不可避免地是不同的. 先前的世界模型只能通过演员的提示来控制,所以描述演员视线以外的事物的提示被迫在演员目前看到的区域内产生幻觉. 相反,我们取消观察员的要求,使控制在观察员所覆盖的更广泛的世界中发挥作用。 图13(a)显示了一个只能以对周围全景的了解来表达的事件. 被放在演员的提示中, 放置在观察者提示中,观察者在周围的世界中生成,演员只有在看到时才会观察. 图13(b)显示了统一提示的不同失败。 演员无法看到周围,在自己的视角中幻化了主体,由于两条溪流是共同产生的,这种幻化现象向观察者传播,尽管观察者已经正确放置了主体. 结果是重复出现,另一个圣诞老人已经坐在椅子上。 脱钩的提示通过给每条流分配一个符合其应观察的提示来避免这种情况.

blocks.en: Appendix E Discussions
blocks.zh: 附录E 讨论情况

blocks.en: E.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: E.1 限制

blocks.en:
World Observer currently assumes panoramic observations as conditioning inputs, which restricts the formulation to settings where such views are available. This requirement could be relaxed by first outpainting a perspective observation into a panorama, allowing the same framework to operate when only perspective inputs are given. The same approach can be applied to multi-observer settings, where multiple panoramic conditions could be constructed from perspective observations at different locations.
Because the observer budget is limited, observing the entire world remains difficult. Nevertheless, flexible observer placement allows this limited budget to be allocated to regions of interest, preserving their dynamics independently of where the actor moves.
blocks.zh:
世界观察家目前将全景观测作为条件投入,这把配制限制在有这种观点的场合. 可以通过首先将一个视角观察投射到全景中来放宽这一要求,在只给出视角输入时允许同一框架运行. 同样的方法可以适用于多观测器设置,从不同位置的视角观测可以构建多个全景条件.
由于观察员预算有限,观察整个世界仍然很困难。 然而,灵活安排观察员可以将这种有限的预算分配给感兴趣的地区,而不管行为者在何处行动,保持其动态。

blocks.en: E.2 Societal impact
blocks.zh: E.2 社会影响

blocks.en: Decoupling observing from acting enables world models to maintain the evolving state of selected regions independently of where the actor moves or looks. This capability can benefit embodied navigation, interactive simulation, and planning, where relevant parts of the world may need to remain continuously represented even when they are not currently observed by the acting agent. Flexible and multi-observer configurations further allow a limited observation budget to be allocated to regions of interest, supporting more persistent world-state maintenance without requiring the actor itself to revisit those regions.
blocks.zh: 将观察与行动脱钩使世界模式能够保持选定区域不断变化的状态,独立于行为者移动或外观。 这种能力可以有利于导航、交互式模拟和规划,因为即使代理机构目前没有观测到这些能力,世界相关地区可能需要继续得到代表。 灵活和多观察员的配置进一步使有限的观察预算能够分配给感兴趣的区域,支持更持久的世界国家维护,而不需要行为者自己重新审视这些区域。
